functions.name: getInterfaces
functions.description: Enumerate network interfaces available for binding.

functions.name: getEffective
functions.description: Resolve the effective interface assignment for a tab. Returns {iface, layer} where layer is 'tab', 'url' (a per-URL rule matched), 'container', 'profile' or ''. The tab's own URL is passed to the service so the URL-rule layer is included; hosts that must never be bound (loopback/LAN/localhost/*.local) never match a rule.

functions.name: setAssignment
functions.description: Assign a network interface to a tab (native binding) and persist it as a sessionstore tab value so it survives restarts. An empty ifaceName clears the tab's binding, falling back to container/profile/unbound.

functions.name: getTabInfo
functions.description: Resolve a tab to {browserId, userContextId, tabValue} - the native keys assignments by browserId; tabValue is the persisted sessionstore binding (survives restore).

functions.name: setProfileInterface
functions.description: Set the profile-layer default interface (empty string clears it).

functions.name: getProfileInterface
functions.description: Get the profile-layer default interface (empty string when unset).

functions.name: getIfaceTrrURI
functions.description: Get the DoH TRR URI override for an interface.

functions.name: getUrlRules
functions.description: Read the per-URL interface rules. Returns {enabled, rules} where rules is [{index, pattern, iface, enabled}], sorted by index. Backed by the rozelynx.netiface.urlrule.<n>.* prefs, so about:config stays the source of truth.

functions.name: setUrlRules
functions.description: Replace the whole per-URL rule list. Writing the prefs is enough to reach the native service (its pref observer rebuilds the rule list); indices past the new length are cleared so a deleted row cannot linger. Returns {ok, error, enabled, rules} with rules re-read from the prefs.

functions.name: setUrlRulesEnabled
functions.description: Turn the per-URL rule layer on or off (pref rozelynx.netiface.urlrules.enabled). Returns {ok, error, enabled}.

functions.name: matchUrlRule
functions.description: Ask the native service which per-URL rule a URL hits. Returns {matched, index, pattern, iface} from the service's own matcher (not a re-implementation), so a preview cannot disagree with the resolver. An empty iface means the rule forces default routing.

functions.name: ensureChip
functions.description: Create the netiface status chip in a window's tab toolbar (no-op when already present).

functions.name: updateChip
functions.description: Update the chip's label, tooltip text and icon in a window.

functions.name: removeChip
functions.description: Remove the netiface chip from a window.

events.name: onChipClick
events.description: Fired when the user clicks the netiface chip. The extension opens its picker popup in response.
